critique: The render confirms the card reads correctly: eight blue interleaved BRAM banks on the -Z edge, an open rail-and-floor butterfly frame exposing the copper multiplier column, dark/steel symmetric add-sub pairs and white registers, the brass twiddle broadcast rail overhead on the highest of three routing layers, the Barrett reduction spine on +X, and the exploded radix-4 unit plus heatsink lifted on visible risers (SIDE/FRONT confirm both sit on supports, not in empty space). Two real, paper-independent defects remained: (1) crossbar_network.spec advertised only '8 read + 8 write per cycle', but eight radix-2 butterflies need 16 operand reads, so a rebuilder would under-provision single-port BRAM; (2) the shift/subtract reduction member (x=3.1, spanning 2.75..3.45) still interpenetrated the Barrett q-multiplier cylinder (x=2.45, east edge 2.95) by ~0.2 m. The dominant remaining weakness is not visual at all — it is source fidelity (the CFNTT conflict-free bank function, the fused per-stage schedule, DIT/DIF direction and authoritative cycle counts are reproduction-invented), and I deliberately did not fabricate replacements: inventing unverified arithmetic poisons the spec substrate and belongs to the reproduce loop with the paper in hand.
changelog: Fixed crossbar port accounting (derivable, not paper-invented): ports now state '16 operand reads + 8 result writes per cycle across 8 dual-port BRAM banks (8 radix-2 butterflies x 2 operand reads = 16; 2 read ports/bank)', and the role + notes now make the dual-port requirement explicit so a rebuilder provisions the BRAM correctly.

Moved mod_red_subshift from x=3.10 to x=3.30 (now spanning 2.95..3.65) so it abuts the Barrett q-multiplier cylinder (east edge 2.95) instead of interpenetrating it by ~0.2 m — removing the last member-on-member overlap in the reduction stage.

Followed the moved member with its dependents: return_post x 3.10->3.30 (stays grounded on the shift/subtract member) and extended return_bus (center x -0.55->-0.45, width 7.3->7.5) so its east end reaches x=3.30 rather than falling short of the relocated member.
remaining_gaps: Source fidelity (reproduce loop, needs the paper): transcribe CFNTT's actual conflict-free bank-index b(i) and offset o(i) from Sec. III — the current (i+(i>>3)) mod 8 map is injective but collides for radix-2 stages s>=6, so crossbar_network.spec.notes' no-conflict claim is an approximation, not the paper's result. Do NOT invent a replacement here; pin it from the source.

Source fidelity: the radix-4 fusion is modeled as a 2x radix-2 composition; the paper's specific fused per-stage schedule and twiddle reuse that yield the quoted 33%/20% op savings remain improvised in config_radix_selector.spec and schedule_controller.spec.fsm.

Source fidelity: forward/inverse decimation direction (DIT vs DIF, stride sign) and authoritative pipeline cycle counts are reproduction defaults (9 cycles/lane); reconcile against the paper before claiming buildability is complete.

Accepted-design (not churn-worthy): the exploded radix-4 unit (z 1.45..3.35) overlaps lanes 5-7 in TOP view. The rubric explicitly endorses an exploded view stacked directly above the enclosure, and any position fully off the array footprint would push it past the board's +Z edge (z=4.5) and read as floating, so I left it. Revisit only if vertical headroom below the heatsink is opened up for a true plan-clear lift.
